description: (c) an ActiveBit entry (FORCED) is present in faults even when its bit is not set

edits.replace:
faults.extend(_extract(hfsr, _HFSR_BITS, "HardFault"))
    faults.append(ActiveBit(category="HardFault", name="FORCED", meaning="forced hard fault, escalated from a configurable fault whose handler is not enabled or itself faulted"))

    debug = _extract(dfsr, _DFSR_BITS, "Debug")
